Container.Name: redis_sure
Container.Overview:
Redis for Sure, pre-configured to work with the Sure and Sure-Worker templates. Used for the background job queue (Sidekiq) and caching.
Full step-by-step guide: https://github.com/Yusseiin/unraid-templates/blob/main/docs/sure-setup.md
BEFORE INSTALLING, create the shared network once from the Unraid terminal (the container will not start without it):
docker network create sure-net
DO NOT RENAME this container: Sure and Sure-Worker connect to it as redis://redis_sure:6379/1. No port is exposed to your LAN; only containers on sure-net can reach it, so no password is needed.
Install order: postgres17_sure, redis_sure, Sure, Sure-Worker.
Container.Requires: The Docker network "sure-net" (create it with: docker network create sure-net).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Redis snapshot folder, so queued jobs survive restarts.
